TOKENFOLLOWCAM.Settings.Enabled.Name: Follow the controlled token
TOKENFOLLOWCAM.Settings.Enabled.Hint: While a token you control moves (WASD, arrows or drag), the camera follows it frame by frame, keeping it centered on screen.
TOKENFOLLOWCAM.Settings.Smoothing.Name: Camera smoothing (ms)
TOKENFOLLOWCAM.Settings.Smoothing.Hint: How softly the camera chases the token. Higher = smoother/lazier glide; lower = snappier; 0 = instant jump to the destination. 150 matches the default token movement speed well.
TOKENFOLLOWCAM.Keybind.ToggleHint: Quickly enables/disables the camera following the controlled token.
